title: Yolculuk

liveClass.title: Resepsiyon
liveClass.goal: Sınıf bir otele dönüşür. Resepsiyon görevlileri ve misafirler rol kartları alır. Misafirler oda ayırtır, giriş yapar ve kartlarındaki sorunu (oda çok gürültülü, yeterince havlu yok, Wi-Fi çok yavaş) kibarca bildirir; görevliler çözüm sunar. Sonunda misafirler otel için kısa bir değerlendirme yazar.

lessons.title: Havalimanı ve istasyon
lessons.goal: Havalimanında ve istasyonda gerekli işleri halledebilir, duyuruları anlayabilirim.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Good morning. Where are you flying to today?

lines.speaker: Sena
lines.text: To London. Here's my passport.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Thank you. How many bags are you checking in?

lines.speaker: Sena
lines.text: Just one. Could I have a window seat, please?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Of course. Here's your boarding pass. Your flight leaves from gate 14, but I'm afraid it's delayed by forty minutes.

lines.speaker: Sena
lines.text: Oh, OK. What time does boarding start?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: At ten fifteen. Have a good flight!

learn.explanation:
**Havalimanında:**

| İfade | Anlam |
|---|---|
| check in (bags) | check-in yapmak, bagaj vermek |
| go through security | güvenlik kontrolünden geçmek |
| boarding pass | biniş kartı |
| gate | kapı |
| board / boarding | uçağa binmek / biniş |
| delayed / cancelled | rötarlı / iptal |
| window / aisle seat | cam kenarı / koridor koltuğu |

**İstasyonda:**

- A **single / return** ticket to Eskişehir, please.
- What time is the **next** train to Ankara?
- Which **platform** does it leave from?
- Do I have to **change** trains? (aktarma)

**Duyurular:** "Flight JE 1985 to London is now boarding at gate 14." / "The 10:30 train to Ankara is delayed."

examples.tr: Koridor tarafında bir koltuk alabilir miyim lütfen?

learn.turkishNote: "Uçağa binmek" = get on the plane ya da board. "Uçaktan inmek" = get off the plane. Rötar süresi "by" ile söylenir: delayed by an hour (bir saat rötarlı). "luggage" sayılamaz: How much luggage? / a piece of luggage.

lessons.title: Otelde
lessons.goal: Otelde oda ayırtabilir, giriş yapabilir ve kibarca rica edebilirim.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Good evening. Welcome to the Sea Breeze Hotel. How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Mr Kurt
lines.text: Hello. I have a reservation for three nights. My name's Kurt.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Ah yes, Mr Kurt. A double room with a sea view. Could you fill in this form, please?

lines.speaker: Mr Kurt
lines.text: Sure. Could I ask what time breakfast is?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: From seven to ten in the garden restaurant. Your room is 305, on the third floor. The lift is on your left.

lines.speaker: Mr Kurt
lines.text: Thank you. And could you wake me up at six tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Of course. Enjoy your stay!

questions.prompt: How many nights is Mr Kurt staying?

learn.explanation:
**Could** ile rica etmek, **can**'den daha kibardır.

| Kalıp | Kullanım | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **Could I** + fiil? | izin / bir şey istemek | **Could I** have a map? / **Could I** pay by card? |
| **Could you** + fiil? | birinden bir şey yapmasını istemek | **Could you** call a taxi? |
| **Could you tell me** + soru? | bilgi istemek | **Could you tell me** where the lift is? |

**Cevaplar:** Of course. / Certainly. / Sure. / I'm afraid not.

**Otel ifadeleri:**

- I have a reservation **for** two nights.
- I'd like a single / double room **with** a sea view.
- Is breakfast **included**? (Kahvaltı dahil mi?)
- What time is **check-out**?

**Dikkat:** Could you tell me **where the lift is**? (where is the lift değil; soru yapısı düz cümleye döner)

examples.en: Could I have a late check-out, please?
Could you recommend a good restaurant?
Could you tell me what time the pool opens?
examples.tr: Havuzun saat kaçta açıldığını söyleyebilir misiniz?

learn.turkishNote: "Could" burada geçmiş zaman değil, kibarlık bildirir: "Could you help me?" = Bana yardım edebilir misiniz? Türkçedeki "-ebilir misiniz" kibar sorusunun tam karşılığıdır. Otelde "Is breakfast included?" sorusu çok işe yarar.

options: Could I have a map, please?
Could you call a taxi for me, please?

lessons.title: Fazla mı, yeterli mi?
lessons.goal: too ve enough ile bir şeyin neden uygun olmadığını açıklayabilirim.

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.text: Excuse me. I'm afraid there's a problem with my room.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: I'm sorry to hear that. What's the matter?

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.text: Well, it's too noisy. It's next to the lift. And it isn't big enough for three people.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: I see. Anything else?

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.text: Yes, there aren't enough towels, and the air conditioning is too loud.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: I'm very sorry. We have a bigger, quieter room on the fifth floor. Would you like to move?

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.text: Yes, please. Thank you.

questions.explanation: "We have a bigger, quieter room... Would you like to move?"

learn.explanation:
**too + sıfat** → gereğinden fazla (sorun var)

- It's **too** noisy. (Fazla gürültülü.)
- This bag is **too** heavy **to** carry. (Taşınamayacak kadar ağır.)

**(not) + sıfat + enough** → yeterince (değil)

- The room **isn't big enough**. (Yeterince büyük değil.)
- Are you **old enough** to drive?

**enough + isim** → yeterli miktarda

- There **aren't enough towels**.
- We don't have **enough time**.

| | Konum |
|---|---|
| too | sıfattan **önce** |
| enough (sıfatla) | sıfattan **sonra** |
| enough (isimle) | isimden **önce** |

**too ve very:** very hot (çok sıcak, ama sorun olmayabilir) / too hot (fazla sıcak, rahatsız edici)

examples.en: The coffee is too hot to drink.
The bed isn't long enough for me.
examples.tr: Yatak benim için yeterince uzun değil.

examples.en: We didn't have enough money for a taxi.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "çok" kelimesi hem very hem too anlamında kullanılır; İngilizcede seçim önemlidir: "This hotel is very expensive" (çok pahalı, belki yine kalırız) ≠ "This hotel is too expensive" (fazla pahalı, kalamayız). enough'un yeri de Türkçeden farklıdır: "yeterince büyük" = big enough (enough big değil).

lessons.title: Nasıl yaptı?
lessons.goal: Tarz zarfları ile bir eylemin nasıl yapıldığını anlatabilirim.

discover.title: Tur rehberi değerlendirmesi
discover.body:
Our guide, Mustafa, was fantastic!

He spoke English and German perfectly, and he explained everything clearly. He drove the minibus carefully on the mountain roads, so we felt safe.

He worked really hard. He answered all our questions patiently, even the silly ones! On the last day it rained heavily, but he quickly found a lovely café for us.

The only problem: he walked very fast! We had to run to keep up. 😄

★★★★★

learn.explanation:
**Tarz zarfları** bir eylemin **nasıl** yapıldığını anlatır. Genellikle **fiilden ya da nesneden sonra** gelir.

**Yapılış:** sıfat + **-ly**

| Sıfat | Zarf |
|---|---|
| slow | slow**ly** |
| careful | careful**ly** |
| quiet | quiet**ly** |
| easy | eas**ily** (y → ily) |
| heavy | heav**ily** |

**Düzensiz zarflar:**

| Sıfat | Zarf |
|---|---|
| good | **well** |
| fast | **fast** |
| hard | **hard** |
| early / late | **early / late** |

**Sıfat mı, zarf mı?**

- He's a **careful** driver. (sıfat → isimden önce)
- He drives **carefully**. (zarf → fiilden sonra)

**Dikkat:** ~~hardly~~ "çok çalışmak" değil, "neredeyse hiç" demektir.

examples.en: Could you speak more slowly, please?
We arrived late because the bus drove slowly.
examples.tr: Otobüs yavaş gittiği için geç vardık.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede sıfat ve zarf çoğu zaman aynı kelimedir: "iyi bir sürücü" / "iyi sürer". İngilizcede fark zorunludur: a good driver / drives well. "He speaks English good" çok yaygın bir hatadır; doğrusu "He speaks English well."

practice.audioText: The receptionist was lovely. She spoke to us politely and explained the city map very clearly.

accepted: He speaks English very well.
He speaks English very well
He speaks very good English.

task.prompt: Yakın zamanda yaptığınız bir yolculuktaki 3 kişiyi (sürücü, rehber, garson, pilot...) tarz zarflarıyla anlatın. En az 5 farklı zarf kullanın.

lessons.title: Değerlendirme yazmak
lessons.goal: Bir otel ya da yolculuk için dengeli bir değerlendirme yazabilir ve şikayetimi kibarca iletebilirim.

discover.title: Otel yorumları
discover.body:
★★★★☆ "Great location, small rooms" – Melis, Ankara
The hotel is in the perfect place, five minutes from the beach. The staff were friendly and worked hard. Breakfast was delicious. However, our room was too small for a family of four, and the walls weren't thick enough. We heard everything!

★★☆☆☆ "Disappointing" – Robert, Manchester
The photos online look amazing, but the reality is different. The pool was too crowded, and there weren't enough sunbeds. The Wi-Fi worked very slowly. I complained at reception, and they answered politely, but nothing changed.

questions.prompt: What was good about the hotel for Melis?
questions.explanation: "in the perfect place... Breakfast was delicious."

questions.prompt: What was Robert's problem at the pool?

learn.explanation:
**İyi bir değerlendirmenin yapısı:**

1. **Başlık ve puan:** "Great location, small rooms" ★★★★☆
2. **Olumlu yanlar:** The staff were friendly. Breakfast was delicious.
3. **Olumsuz yanlar:** **However**, the room was too small.
4. **Sonuç / tavsiye:** I would recommend it for couples, but not for families.

**Bağlaçlar:**

- **but** (cümle içinde): The room was nice, **but** it was small.
- **However,** (yeni cümle başında, virgülle): The room was nice. **However,** it was small.
- **also / too**: The staff were **also** helpful. / The food was great **too**.

**Kibar şikayet:**

- I'm afraid there's a problem with ...
- I'd like to complain about ...
- Could you possibly ...?
- I'm not happy with ...

examples.en: The room was clean. However, it was too noisy.
I would recommend this hotel to families.
I'd like to complain about the Wi-Fi.

learn.turkishNote: "However" resmi yazıda "but"tan daha uygundur ve genellikle yeni cümlenin başına gelip ardından virgül alır. "recommend" kalıbı: recommend something to someone (birine bir şeyi tavsiye etmek). İngilizcede "staff" çoğul fiil alabilir: The staff were friendly.

options: I'm afraid there's a problem with the Wi-Fi.
practice.explanation: I'm afraid there's a problem with...

task.modelAnswer:
★★★★☆ "Lovely staff, slow Wi-Fi"
We stayed at the Blue Bay Hotel in Fethiye for five nights. The location was great and the rooms were very clean. The staff spoke English well and helped us quickly when we had a problem. Breakfast was delicious too. However, the Wi-Fi was too slow, and there weren't enough sunbeds by the pool in the afternoon. I would definitely recommend this hotel to couples and families.

questions.prompt: Bir otele kibar bir şikayet e-postası yazın (70–90 kelime): kaldığınız tarihi, 3 sorunu (too / enough kullanarak), personelin nasıl davrandığını (tarz zarfı) ve ne istediğinizi yazın.
questions.modelAnswer:
Dear Manager,
I stayed at your hotel from 3 to 6 August in room 214. I'm afraid I had some problems. The room was too hot because the air conditioning didn't work, and it wasn't big enough for two people. Also, there weren't enough towels. The receptionist spoke to me politely, but nobody fixed the problems. Could you possibly give me a partial refund?
Yours faithfully,
Can Öztürk
